items.note: The PRD only calls it a "note-taking app" and never says B2B. It also lists "Who are the intended users... (Not provided)" as an open question, which means the given B2B context wasn't used.
The Overview says the document is for engineering and design leads deciding whether v1 scope is clear enough to start work, which fits a kickoff.
Workspace creation, inviting members by email, and shared notes are all in the In v1 scope list, and each has its own requirements section.
v1 has only admin and member. Requirement 18 says explicitly that no other roles exist in v1.
Billing changes, SSO, and guest access are listed under Out of v1.
The primary target is stated exactly: 20% of paid accounts create a workspace within 60 days. The secondary metrics are clearly marked as proposed.
At roughly 1,000–1,100 words in compact sections, it's about 2 pages.
Migration is marked as an open question in both Scope and Section 7, with considerations listed and no decision made. The requirements are written so they don't assume an answer.
